:::{#def-level-curve}
#### Level curve

Let $f : \reals^2 \to \reals$ and let $c$ be a real number.
The **level curve** of $f$ at $c$
is the [level set](#def-level-set) of $f$ at $c$
when that set is a curve in the plane.
It is the special case $p = 2$ of a level set.
A [contour line](algebra-exponentials.qmd#def-contour-line)
is a level curve drawn on a plot of $f$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-level-curve}
#### A level curve of $x_1^2 + x_2^2$

Let $f(\vx) = x_1^2 + x_2^2$ for $\vx = \tp{(x_1, x_2)}$.
The level curve at $4$ is the circle of radius $2$ around $\vzero$.

:::
